summary: Verified production menasti.com public contact info now matches preview after main agent's authorized partial settings PUT. Both API and browser checks pass on production and preview; no old placeholders remain.

action_items: OPTIONAL: The served production build renders [data-testid=footer-email] but NOT [data-testid=footer-phone] in the site-wide Footer component. If product requires footer to display the phone, main agent should add footer-phone alongside footer-email in Footer.jsx and redeploy. Contact page itself shows both correctly.
OPTIONAL/UNRELATED: Investigate the marketing pages' 401 console warnings from auth-gated resource fetches for non-authenticated visitors (cosmetic, not caused by this settings change).
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause (as noted by deployer): production and preview use separate DB instances; redeploy does not sync data. Recommend either (a) making seeded/default contact info idempotent on backend boot when contact_details_version bumps, or (b) adding an ops runbook step to replay settings changes on production DB. Otherwise every preview-only settings edit will silently drift from production.

public_settings should ensure any newly-added fields have defaults so a partially-updated document does not leave stale keys behind. Current $set-only update in admin.update_settings is correct but relies on operator remembering to touch every environment.

rca of the issue: Production DB previously held stale default contact values (info@manasati.sa / +966500000000) because preview and production run on independent MongoDB stores; the preview-only admin settings update never propagated. Main agent performed a single authorized partial PUT to /api/admin/settings on production with contact_email, contact_phone, contact_details_version fields only. GET /api/public/settings on menasti.com now returns the corrected values, and the served Contact page + homepage footer-email reflect them with mailto:/tel: links intact and no old placeholders remaining. Mitigation: automate cross-environment settings replay or add idempotent seed-on-version-bump on backend startup.
